question: Should Skill Workshop expose exact proposal review through the core model-facing tool and make pending approvals fail when the proposal version changes?
rationale: This adds a permanent core tool contract and intentionally tightens an existing approval race; tests establish mechanics but cannot establish maintainer intent for the product and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept review and version binding
options.body: Adopt the new tool surface and safer fail-closed approval semantics after real user-path proof.

options.title: Narrow the tool contract
options.body: Keep the service projection but redesign or defer model-facing pagination and approval binding.

options.title: Keep preview UI-only
options.body: Decline the agent-tool surface and improve the existing Control UI preview instead.

recommendation.title: Accept review and version binding
recommendation.body: Adopt the new tool surface and safer fail-closed approval semantics after real user-path proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently reviewed and merged the Skill Workshop approval boundary and is the strongest available decision-routing signal.
